sloka: तावद्भिः एव चिच्छेद शरैः कांचन भूषितैः ।ततः पश्चात् महातेजा नाराचान् सूर्य संनिभान् ॥३-२०-१८॥
transliteration: tāvadbhiḥ eva ciccheda śaraiḥ kāṁcana bhūṣitaiḥ ।tataḥ paścāt mahātejā nārācān sūrya saṁnibhān ॥3-20-18॥

translations.english: Rama took the bow, stretched it and aimed at his target, the demons and sent the arrows as Indra would release the thunderbolt.
